GNU LibreDWG - the DWG converter bundled with ConvertCAD
=========================================================

dxf2dwg / dwg2dxf are built from GNU LibreDWG 0.13.4, free software
licensed under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later (COPYING).

Corresponding source code:
  * upstream source (unmodified):
      https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/releases/tag/0.13.4
      https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/libredwg/libredwg-0.13.4.tar.xz
  * a copy of that source, the two ConvertCAD patches and the build script,
    in the ConvertCAD source repository:
      vendor/libredwg/libredwg-0.13.4.tar.xz
      vendor/libredwg/patches/*.patch
      scripts/build_libredwg.sh

The patches fix two bugs in the DXF reader (src/in_dxf.c): every linetype
was listed twice in the DWG linetype table, and reading a large DXF was
very slow. Nothing else is changed.
